UpdateSourceArgs: -c "export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0; cd Gatekeeper; DownloadSource=\"{{DownloadSource}}\"; DownloadBranch=\"{{DownloadBranch}}\"; [[ -z \"$DownloadBranch\" ]] && DownloadBranch=main; if [[ -n \"{{DownloadUsername}}\" ]]; then DownloadUrl=\"${DownloadSource/https:\/\//https:\/\/{{DownloadUsername}}:{{DownloadPassword}}@}\"; else DownloadUrl=\"$DownloadSource\"; fi; if [ ! -d .git ]; then echo \"Installing Gatekeeper\" && git clone \"$DownloadUrl\" tmp_src && cp -r tmp_src/. . && rm -rf tmp_src && git checkout \"$DownloadBranch\" --force && git pull && echo \"Gatekeeper installed\"; else echo \"Updating Gatekeeper\" && git remote set-url origin \"$DownloadUrl\" && git fetch origin && git checkout \"$DownloadBranch\" --force && git pull && echo \"Gatekeeper updated\"; fi"

-c "cd Gatekeeper && rm -rf pydeps && mkdir -p pydeps && curl -sSL https://bootstrap.pypa.io/get-pip.py -o get-pip.py && PYTHONPATH=pydeps python3 get-pip.py --target=pydeps --no-warn-script-location >/dev/null && PYTHONPATH=pydeps python3 -m pip install --target=pydeps --no-warn-script-location -r requirements.txt && rm -f get-pip.py"
